# ENDevo

> Legacy readiness and digital preparedness. ENDevo helps people know exactly what they need to put in order — legally, financially, digitally and medically — and in what order to do it. The product is Legacy Readiness OS, sold in two editions: for individuals, and for enterprise. The deliverable a person walks away with is called My Final Playbook.

ENDevo is led by Niki Weiss, a thanatologist and former enterprise project manager who treats end-of-life planning as the project it is: decisions, dependencies, and a finished deliverable. The company publishes a weekly podcast, Death and Dying in the Digital Age, and a library of articles written from those conversations.

ENDevo does not draft legal documents. It tells you which documents you need, what order to handle them in, and what to gather before you sit down with an attorney.

## Start here

- [Legacy Readiness OS — how it works and pricing](https://www.endevo.life/start-here): The two editions side by side, the five steps, the video, and the sign-up. Individual pricing is $500 for a year of access, with founding-member pricing of $100 for the first 200 people through 15 January 2027. Enterprise pricing is on request.
- [Pricing](https://www.endevo.life/pricing): Goes directly to the pricing section.
- [The full program](https://www.endevo.life/program): The enterprise program explained in depth, with case studies.

## Who it is for

- [Individuals and families](https://www.endevo.life/for-individuals): For a person getting their own affairs in order.
- [Employers](https://www.endevo.life/for-employers): Legacy readiness as an employee benefit. Private workspace per organization; the employer sees participation and topics, never what any individual wrote.
- [Advisors and providers](https://www.endevo.life/for-service-providers): For financial advisors, attorneys and planners who want to bring the platform to clients they already serve.

## Common questions

- [FAQ](https://www.endevo.life/faq): Straight answers on end-of-life planning as an employee benefit, why most people never finish their planning, and how to propose it to an employer.
- What is legacy readiness? Knowing what you need to put in order — legally, financially, digitally and medically — and in what order to do it, as a structured plan with milestones and a date rather than a checklist that is never finished.
- How much does it cost for an individual? $500 for a year of access, no subscription. Founding-member pricing of $100 is open to the first 200 people through 15 January 2027. You can take the assessment and see your plan before paying.
- How is this different from estate planning with a lawyer? ENDevo drafts nothing. It tells you which documents you need, in what order, and what to gather beforehand — so the attorney conversation is shorter and costs less.
- Can employers offer legacy readiness as a benefit? Yes. Legacy Readiness OS for Enterprise gives an organization a private tenant where every employee builds their own plan, with participation reporting and no visibility into individual content.

## Podcast

- [Death and Dying in the Digital Age](https://www.endevo.life/podcast): 85 episodes with guests across estate law, financial planning, hospice and palliative care, funeral direction, death technology and digital legacy. Every episode has its own page with a transcript-grounded summary.

## Articles

Written from the podcast conversations, carrying the guests' own words and arguments.

- [Your Estate Plan Can Be Perfect and Still Fail](https://www.endevo.life/blog/your-estate-plan-can-be-perfect-and-still-fail): Why an unfunded trust and an outdated beneficiary designation quietly override a will. With Bryan Walley of Forward Inheritance.
- [Your Will Is a Rudimentary Document](https://www.endevo.life/blog/your-will-is-a-rudimentary-document): What a digital twin could carry that a will cannot, and what nobody has decided about who owns it. With Dr. Cory Goldberg.
- [What Long-Term Care Really Costs, and Why Most Families Are Not Ready](https://www.endevo.life/blog/what-long-term-care-really-costs-and-why-most-families-are-not-ready): The real monthly numbers, and why Medicare does not cover them.
- [Why Talking About Death Helps Us Live More Fully](https://www.endevo.life/blog/why-talking-about-death-helps-us-live-more-fully): On the active dying phase and what caregivers are never told.
- [Planning for Digital Legacy Transfer With Ease Online](https://www.endevo.life/blog/planning-for-digital-legacy-transfer-with-ease-online): Handing over accounts, photographs and records so a family can actually reach them.
- [Planning for a Special Needs Child: Lifetime of Care](https://www.endevo.life/blog/planning-for-a-special-needs-child-lifetime-of-care): Special needs trusts, guardianship after 18, and the cost gap most families do not see coming.
- [All articles](https://www.endevo.life/blog): 82 articles on digital legacy and end-of-life planning.
